headline: TXT take first 'Angel Bite' win on 'Show Champion'
sub: First music show trophy for the 'PERFECT STORM' title track
caption:
TXT have won their first music show trophy for 'Angel Bite'!

The group took first place on the Nov 25 episode of MBC M's 'Show Champion', a special episode that aired past performances. 'Angel Bite' is the title track of their 9th mini album 'PERFECT STORM', released Nov 16. Other first-place nominees were RESCENE, ATEEZ, NCT DREAM and BIGBANG.

📌 Source: MBC M 'Show Champion'
